notes: Four distinct movable-part episodes are visible: two independently manipulated upper-cabinet doors and two separate drawers. The two cabinet-door transitions overlap closely, so their individual midpoint assignments are less certain than the drawer timings.
scene_description: A user surveys a compact kitchen, opens both doors of the cabinet above the refrigerator, opens a food drawer left of the oven and a utensil/storage drawer right of the oven, then closes each manipulated part.
